errors.text: The falsification logic is reversed: preventing HCP/stacking-fault formation and thereby eliminating the friction spike would support the proposed causal role of those defects rather than falsify it.

Changing the interatomic potential to suppress an FCC-to-HCP transformation also changes stacking-fault energy, elastic response, defect mobility, and thermal stability, so the intervention cannot cleanly distinguish thermal disorder from mechanical annealing.
The proposed experiment lacks unloaded, thermally aged controls at each temperature, which are necessary to separate temperature-driven disorder from indentation-driven dislocation annihilation.
